title: Mince garlic
summary: Peel and finely chop a garlic clove without losing a fingertip.
notes: Knife lesson: safety first, no roasts while the knife is moving.

steps.instruction: Lay the flat of the knife on the clove and press down firmly with your palm to crack the skin, then peel it off.
looks_wrong: edge of the blade facing your hand
smashing with fingers near the edge

steps.instruction: Slice the clove thinly, then gather the slices and rock the knife back and forth over them, keeping the tip on the board.
looks_right: knife tip stays on the board
fingers on top of the blade spine, away from the edge
steps.done_when: The garlic is in tiny, even pieces.
